compare.title: Compare two git refs
compare.description: Run one agent at two branches, tags or commits on the same tasks.
compare.noAgents: No agents yet. Create one on the Agents page first.
compare.repoProject: This project's own git repository (local server only)
compare.connect: Connect GitHub to pick a repository and its branches
compare.connectHint: A hosted project has no git history: connect GitHub, or type the refs of a local repository when running the server on your machine.
compare.budget: Budget (USD, required unless both setups are scripted)
compare.confirm: Read the agent files at both refs, write the experiment and start it?
compare.missing: Pick an agent, a benchmark and two different refs.
compare.same: The two refs are the same: pick two different refs.

replay.title: Replay blamed failures (tier 2)
replay.description: Runs each blamed team failure again with the suspect swapped for a stub agent, through your workers, and writes the replay verdict into blame.json. Runs agents again, so it costs model calls.
replay.confirm: Replay blamed failures of {{expId}}? Each replay runs two agent runs.
replay.none: No blamed team failure to replay: run Blame first, tier 2 only tests failures pinned on one team member.
